تَبِنٌ Intelligent, sagacious, skilful, or knowing; and nice, or minute, in inspection (S, M, K) into affairs; (S;) as also طَبِنٌ: (M:) [or very intelligent, &c.: and accord. to some, in evil: or in good: see تَبِنَ.] ―
-b2- And One who plays with his hand with everything. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
